Split a long CONSORT flowchart across multiple pages

Source: R/plot.R
paginate_consort.Rd

For diagrams that exceed a page height (e.g. many steps with many groups), this function renders the tracker as a list of consort_grob objects, one per page. Steps are split greedily: each page holds as many steps as fit within page_height_mm. The last step of every page is repeated as the first step of the next page (overlap), so the reader always sees where each page continues from.

Usage

paginate_consort(
  tracker,
  page_height_mm = 257,
  na_cells = NULL,
  step_labels = NULL,
  group_labels = NULL,
  font_size = 1,
  box_width = NULL,
  excl_width = NULL
)

Arguments

tracker

A cohort object or tracker tibble (same as consort_plot()).

page_height_mm

Usable page height in mm. Default 257 (A4 with standard top/bottom margins). For US Letter use approximately 241.

na_cells, step_labels, group_labels, font_size, box_width, excl_width

Passed through to consort_plot() for each page.

Value

A list of consort_grob objects. Each element also carries a .page_info attribute: list(page = i, n_pages = n, steps = <chr>).

Details

Save the result with save_consort_pages().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
pages <- paginate_consort(cohort, page_height_mm = 257)
save_consort_pages(pages, "output/consort")
} # }
